text:
Sam: Kicking off a blue->green shift for v2.9.0 in 10m. Change window 23:00-01:00 PT. Plan: 5% increments every 3m, auto-pause on p95>200ms or errors>0.5%. Ill post live updates.
ReleaseBot: Pipeline triggered: deploy/v2.9.0/canary -> pool-east-2. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/blue-green-shift. Auto-alerts enabled.
Jess: Quick Q  are we pinning router binary to 2.3.1 for the window to avoid header churn?
Mohit: Yep, orchestrator pinned router=2.3.1 for this rollout. LB config passed staging smoke.
Sam: Ops snippet (on-call):
```
# set green weight (router-admin)
curl -X POST "https://router-admin.internal/weights" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"green": 15, "blue": 85}'
# verify route
curl "https://router-admin.internal/status" | jq .routes.myservice
```
deploy-bot: weight update applied: green=5 -> green=10 (step 2). Dash: https://grafana/team/releases/v2.9.0
Morgan: Watching metrics. p50 steady, p95 creeping: 185ms at green=10. No 5xx spike yet.
Sam: Continue. Add canary metrics to changelog and note rollback criteria.
deploy-bot: weight update applied: green=15 (step 3).
Morgan: Alert: error-rate = 0.62% at 15% green (threshold 0.5%). Pausing rollout.
Sam: Paused. Decision time: immediate rollback to blue or debug while holding at 15%?
Jess: If errors are correlated with traffic, prefer rollback. Anyone sampling traces?
Mohit: Traces show connector-x timeouts on green nodes. Looks like a dependency regression introduced in v2.9.0.
Sam: Decision: rollback. Set green=0, mark v2.9.0 as failed for now. Execute rollback steps.
deploy-bot: Executing rollback: setting green=0 -> blue=100. Verifying health checks.
ReleaseBot: Rollback complete. Canary terminated. Incident stub INC-7891 created. Please update postmortem with RCA.
Morgan: Post-rollback metrics: p95 -> 140ms, errors -> 0.08%. Healthy.
Jess: Adding note for release notes: "v2.9.0 rollout paused and rolled back due to connector-x timeouts; router pinning prevented header churn; dev team to patch dependency."
Sam: Thanks all. Next steps: devs to fix connector regression; will schedule narrow reattempt after patch and additional staging validation. :thumbsup:
